items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Kid Thomas was telling us. He used to play with you.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever play much in brass bands on the street? I know I used to hear you a few years ago. Yeah. Oh, Kid Thomas was telling us. He used to play with you. Yeah.
I played in all of them brass bands and played many, many, many, many, many. Three years ago.
